h: A break on the M6 near Coventry
p: Corley sits on the M6 just north of Coventry, which makes it a handy stop on a lot of long journeys up and down the motorway. If you're breaking up a long drive, it's worth stopping for a proper stretch rather than just a quick coffee.

If you have time to come off the motorway, Coventry is only a short drive away. The ruined old cathedral and the modern Coventry Cathedral stand side by side in the city centre, and the free Coventry Transport Museum has a huge collection of cars, bikes and buses.
The GameZone here is 18+, and it's a place for a quick play rather than a day out.
